exceptions.acceptedBy: Maintainer, explicit approval in the security remediation task
exceptions.reason: Temporary accepted development risk. Firebase CLI still requires the incompatible CommonJS stream-json 1.x paths. The repository wrapper blocks Auth import and Hosting commands; only Firestore deployment, bounded local emulator tests and basic account setup are supported. Direct invocation of node_modules Firebase CLI is outside this mitigation. Remove when a compatible patched parent is available.
